name: xliff-validation
description: XLIFF validation tool based on TypesXLIFF package

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && node dist/copy-assets.js && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const p='dist/xliffvalidator.js'; if (fs.existsSync(p)) { try { fs.chmodSync(p, 0o755); } catch {} }"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const p='dist/xliffvalidator.js'; if (fs.existsSync(p)) { try { fs.chmodSync(p, 0o755); } catch {} }"
